full_details: Before church you marked the almanac for the twins' day and set two groats and a twist of comfits by the inkhorn. The letter was not written yet. At St Helen's Master Thwaite preached on a candle that is spent, and was not brief. You caught yourself on the owl. Sir John Spencer sat three rows ahead and did not turn. At dinner the penny loaf was a finger short of the notch. Meat at the board was threepence. Alse offered to run a letter to the Bell, and you refused, because the carrier is not there until Thursday. Firing and washing stay sixpence a week until Lady Day. At three you wrote home. Hamnet and Judith are ten. Two groats went into the paper, to be spent foolishly, with the comfits. Susanna keeps a riddle. Anne was told you are mended of the cold, the comedy is done, and that Lent can wait until you know the day. At night the packet was still on the desk.
one_sentence: You went to St Helen's, ate the short loaf, and wrote the twins a letter that stays until Thursday.
title: Went to St Helen's and wrote the twins' letter
